articles.summary: Fairfax, VA., October 26, 2026 – MainStreet Bancshares, Inc. (Nasdaq: MNSB MNSBP), the financial holding company for MainStreet Bank, reported net income of $3.6 million for the quarter-ended September 30, 2026, resulting in earnings per common share of $0.43. The net interest margin was 3.55% for the quarter, up two basis points from the previous quarter.
